name: a_frz
asks: D30 frozen cell at T=10. mk_dev as-shipped. The control.

name: a_unf
asks: D30 unfrozen cell at T=10. If fwd/tb_err falls here and rises in a_frz, the 2026-08-07 result replicates at 4.5x length and synthesis.md section 1s thesis -- policy trained entirely off-policy, fwd trains only Z -- is in trouble.

name: c_frz_rep20
asks: FROZEN, fixed mix {'fwd': 0.2, 'bwd': 0.6, 'replay': 0.2}. rep20 is the pinned-mix control (isolates "controller off" from "more replay"); rep40 doubles replay weight. Both read against a_unf, which got LESS replay (0.238) than a_frz (0.286) and still won.
